THRG.description: Time History Analysis Results Graph - General Link (THRG). Defines a time-history result graph item for a General Link, keyed by item id; THIS_NAME selects the time-history load case and GENERAL_LINK the target link, while TYPE_RES/LOCATION/COMP select which result quantity is plotted.

THIS_NAME.description: Name of the time-history (load case) to read results from; resolved to the internal time-history load case key.

TYPE_RES.description: Type of result to graph, integer code (e.g. 0 = Force-Deformation, 1 = Force, 2 = Deformation).

LOCATION.description: Location along the General Link element, integer code (e.g. 0 = i-end, 1 = j-end).

COMP.description: Result component, integer code selecting the direction/degree of freedom (e.g. 0 = Fx/Dx, 1 = Fy/Dy, 2 = Fz/Dz, 3 = Mx/Rx, 4 = My/Ry, 5 = Mz/Rz).

GENERAL_LINK.description: General Link element number to read results from.
